[SWS_EM_02316] Unexpected Termination of a process not configured for the RequestedState during a Function Group State transition
⌈
In case of
Unexpected Termination of a process not configured for the RequestedState
during a Function Group State, Execution Management shall continue the
Function Group State transition and log the event, if logging is activated.
⌋

[SWS_EM_02316] Unexpected Termination of a process not configured for the Requested State during a Function Group State transition
⌈
In case of Unexpected Termination of a Process not configured for the
RequestedState during a Function Group State, Execution Management
shall continue the Function Group State transition and log the event, if logging
is activated.
⌋

[SWS_EM_02316] Abnormal Termination of a Process not configured for the Re- quested State during a Function Group State transition
⌈
In case of Abnormal Termination of a Process not configured for the Request-
edState during a Function Group State, Execution Management shall con-
tinue the Function Group State transition and log DltMessage ProcessAbnor-
malTermination, if logging is activated.
⌋
